item.text: “I’m really enjoying having you here and spending time together. I’ve realized I recharge best if I have about an hour of quiet time to myself each afternoon—nothing personal at all. Would you mind if I took that time to read, rest, or catch up on a few things? Afterward, I’d love to reconnect and make plans for the evening. I hope that feels okay; I want us both to be comfortable.”
